team.name: Alpha 2130
team.tagline: Robots, resources, and the people who build them.
team.about: This is the Wiki for members of Alpha 2130. This has every resource for every sub team you will need along with details of our previous bots.

robots.name: Example Bot
robots.description: Replace this with a real robot. Describe the game strategy, standout mechanisms, and what made this robot unique. Delete this entry once you've added your own robots in the Admin page.

subteams.name: CAD
subteams.description: Designs the robot in 3D before it's built, iterating on mechanisms and checking for fit and function.

subteams.name: Programming
subteams.description: Writes and tests the code that drives the robot's mechanisms, autonomous routines, and driver controls.

subteams.name: Build
subteams.description: Fabricates and assembles the robot from raw stock and CAD designs.

subteams.name: Business
subteams.description: Handles outreach, fundraising, awards submissions, and team documentation.

subteams.name: Electrical
subteams.description: Wires and maintains the robot's electrical systems, from battery to sensors.
